mass_provenance.method: YCB tomato soup can total mass 349 g, used as a close dimensional analogue to this 65 mm diameter x 100 mm can.
mass_provenance.reference_type: published robotics benchmark total mass adopted for a comparable object
mass_provenance.notes: Printed 305 g denotes contents only (10.75 oz, rounded); USD mass includes the can. Contents are represented as a single rigid body.

physical_material_provenance: engineering starting estimates; pair-dependent and uncalibrated
inertia_provenance: uniform-density integration of collision proxies; overlapping compound parts counted additively
limitations: Rigid approximation; no crushing, breakage, liquids or electronics behavior.
Visual micro-details are omitted from collision where not contact-critical.
No task-specific robot grasp success claim.
